verdict.rationale: Typesense's own docs say the open-source server can be self-hosted on your own computer or any server, with the full API surface. That lets users decide where their data physically lives. The evidence does not show a documented region or residency selector for Typesense Cloud, or any explicit data-residency commitment. missing for 10: documented Typesense Cloud region selection, explicit data-residency guarantees/docs, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)

citations.quote: Typesense is an open source search engine that can be downloaded and run from your computer locally or from any server.
Self-host it free forever or run the same engine in a dedicated Typesense Cloud cluster.
the freedom to self-host or use a dedicated Typesense Cloud cluster
